# International Journal of Engineering Research & Technology (IJERT)

> > IJERT is an open-access academic journal publishing peer-reviewed research in engineering, technology, and applied sciences with focus on wireless communications, signal processing, embedded systems, and computational methods.

The journal covers diverse engineering domains including telecommunications (OFDM, DSSS, MANETS), hardware design (MIPS processors, FPGA), signal processing (BCI, emotion detection), and interdisciplinary studies. All content is published under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License, with significant contributions from researchers across India and international institutions.

## Key Topics

- Wireless Communication Systems
- OFDM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing)
- DSSS (Direct Sequence Spread Spectrum)
- Cryptography and Security
- MIPS Processor Design
- Bit Error Rate (BER) Analysis
- Mobile Ad-hoc Networks (MANETS)
- Signal Processing
- FPGA Implementation
- Modulation Techniques (BPSK, QPSK, M-PSK)
- TCP/IP Protocols
- Brain-Computer Interface (BCI)
- Embedded Systems
- Finite Element Analysis (FEA)
- Simulink Modeling

## Wireless Communications & Networking

- [Design and Analysis of Bit Error Rate Performance of Simulink based DSSS-OFDM Model for Wireless Communication](https://www.ijert.org/design-and-analysis-of-bit-error-rate-perfornance-of-simulink-based-dsss-ofdm-model-for-wireless-communication): BER analysis of DSSS-OFDM wireless model by Koringa & Patel (2012)
- [Analysis of QoS Attributes for AODV Routing Protocol in MANETS](https://www.ijert.org/analysis-of-qos-attributes-for-aodv-routing-protocol-in-manets): QoS analysis of AODV routing in MANETs by Sireesha & Geeta (2012)
- [Dynamic Spreading Code Allocation Strategy for A Downlink MC-CDMA System](https://www.ijert.org/dynamic-spreading-code-allocation-strategy-for-a-downlink-mc-cdma-system): MC-CDMA downlink spreading code allocation by Chandrika & Mytri (2012)
- [Implementation of A Loss Differentiation Algorithm For Differentiation of Non-congestion Losses From Congestion Losses For Improving TCP Performance Over Wireless Networks](https://www.ijert.org/implementation-of-a-loss-differentiation-algorithm-for-differentiation-of-non-congestion-losses-from-congestion-losses-for-improving-tcp-performance-over-wireless-networks): TCP loss differentiation algorithm for wireless by Dalwadi (2012)

## Hardware Design & Cryptography

- [Design of High Performance MIPS Cryptography Processor Based on T-DES Algorithm](https://www.ijert.org/design-of-high-performance-mips-cryptography-processor-based-on-t-des-algorithm): MIPS T-DES cryptography processor design by Singh & Parmar (2012)
- [Cryptographic of high Security Hash Functions](https://www.ijert.org/cryptographic-of-high-security-hash-functions): High security cryptographic hash function analysis by Kumar et al. (2012)
- [Honeypots : Fighting Against Spam](https://www.ijert.org/honeypots-fighting-against-spam): Honeypot-based spam prevention techniques by Shukla & Hans (2012)
- [Design of Small-Gm Operational Tranconductance Amplifier in 0.18μm Technology](https://www.ijert.org/design-of-small-gm-operational-tranconductance-amplifier-in-0-18m-technology): Small-Gm OTA design in 0.18μm CMOS by Palodiya et al. (2012)

## Signal Processing & Biomedical Engineering

- [EEG Signal Processing and Classification of Sensorimoter rhythm-based BCI](https://www.ijert.org/eeg-signal-processing-and-classification-of-sensorimoter-rhythm-based-bci): Sensorimotor rhythm BCI using EEG by Mishra & Somani (2012)
- [Statistical Analysis Of Emotion Detection Using Fundamental Frequency](https://www.ijert.org/statistical-analysis-of-emotion-detection-using-fundamental-frequency): Emotion detection via fundamental frequency by Vasavi et al. (2012)
- [New Controlled State-Expansion Sequence Estimation for TCM](https://www.ijert.org/new-controlled-state-expansion-sequence-estimation-for-tcm): TCM sequence estimation technique by Niranjan & Shivakumar (2012)

## Embedded Systems & Automation

- [Automation of Railway Gate Control Using Microcontroller](https://www.ijert.org/automation-of-railway-gate-control-using-microcontroller): 8052 microcontroller railway gate automation by Dewangan et al. (2012)
- [Inverter Topologies for Photovoltaic Modules with p-sim Software](https://www.ijert.org/inverter-topologies-for-photovoltaic-modules-with-p-sim-software): PV inverter topologies simulated in P-SIM by Acharya et al. (2012)
- [Dynamic Economic Load Dispatch with Emission and Loss using GAMS](https://www.ijert.org/dynamic-economic-load-dispatch-with-emission-and-loss-using-gams): GAMS-based economic dispatch optimization by Bisen & Dubey (2012)

## Structural & Materials Engineering

- [Computer Aided Analysis of Multiple Cylindrical Shell Structure Using Different Parameters](https://www.ijert.org/computer-aided-analysis-of-multiple-cylindrical-shell-structure-using-different-parameters): Parametric analysis of cylindrical shells by Rai & Pendharkar (2012)
- [Analysis Of Mechanical, Electrical & Physical Behaviour of The Composite Tube (Epoxy/Glass) Made Up of Different Angle Through Filament Winding Technique & Design Optimization By Using FEA](https://www.ijert.org/analysis-of-mechanical-electrical-physical-behaviour-of-the-composite-tube-epoxyglass-made-up-of-different-angle-through-filament-winding-technique-design-optimization-by-using-fea): FEA optimization of filament-wound epoxy/glass tubes by Soni & Dubey (2012)
- [Effect of Plant Roots On Soil Anti-Scouribility of Topsoil During Concentrated Flow](https://www.ijert.org/effect-of-plant-roots-on-soil-anti-scouribility-of-topsoil-during-concentrated-flow): Plant root effects on soil erosion resistance by Shit & Maiti (2012)

## Optional: Interdisciplinary Studies

- [Entrepreneurship avenues through Technical & Vocational Education in Rural India : A Study of Marathwada region of Maharashtra state](https://www.ijert.org/entrepreneurship-avenues-through-technical-vocational-education-in-rural-india-a-study-of-marathwada-region-of-maharashtra-state): Vocational education entrepreneurship in Marathwada by Dhande (2012)
- [Determination of Awareness Level for Green Marketing Among Dealers and Customers in 800CC-2000CC Segment of Cars](https://www.ijert.org/determination-of-awareness-level-for-green-marketing-among-dealers-and-customers-in-800cc-2000cc-segment-of-cars): Green marketing awareness in automotive sector by Dubey & Gurjar (2012)
- [Evolution of Mobile Number Portability](https://www.ijert.org/evolution-of-mobile-number-portability): Mobile number portability evolution by Anjum & Dua (2012)
